newsitem.title: USA: SFX sets Multi-Market exchange ratio.
newsitem.headline: SFX sets Multi-Market exchange ratio.

text.p: SFX Broadcasting Inc said on Monday that in merging Multi-Market Radio Inc into SFX, each Multi-Market share would be converted into the right to receive 0.2983 shares of SFX common stock.

When the deal was entered into and in subsequent financing documents, an SFX stock price of $35 per share and an exchange ratio of 0.3286 were assumed, the company said. The new ratio was based on a price of $41.91 per SFX share over the 20-day trading pricing period which ended on November 15.
Under the new exchange ratio, there would be about 10 percent fewer shares issued than anticipated in previous pro forma statements, and fewer total outstanding SFX shares, the company said.
The merger was expected to close after meetings of both companies shareholders on November 22, SFX said.
